en-US:
Corpán 0.13.1 — the Parlometron release.
Parlometron arrives, formerly the Pronunciation Coach. A full rebrand and a new multiplayer mode: pass-the-phone pronunciation duels in any of Corpán's 51 languages, scored on-device by Whisper. No servers, no accounts. Solo practice is still there for the quieter days.
A new Large q8 ★ model option ships with Parlometron — our own 8-bit quantization of Whisper Large v3, about 1.6 GB, delivered from our CDN. Noticeably faster than the default Large on most phones, at the same accuracy.
Steadier on-device speech: • Model swaps no longer crash the app. A memory-headroom gate inspects free RAM before loading and refuses cleanly when a load would exceed safe limits. • The iPhone microphone indicator no longer stays on after you leave a pronunciation session — the audio engine is fully torn down when the pack closes. • Back-to-back recordings work reliably on iPhone and Android, and TTS volume between mic tries is back to full.
Sturdier on Android 15+. The Whisper native library is now 16 KB page-size aligned, so it loads natively on Pixel 9 and other 2025+ Android devices without the slow 4 KB emulation shim. Snappier startup, slightly better battery on new hardware.
Main-screen polish: • The language stack now picks its vertical placement to fit your text size and stack count without ever clipping the last row under the nav bar. • Onboarding's language picker scrolls cleanly on small devices when the coming-soon list runs long.
Privacy. Anonymous, opt-out usage analytics arrive in Settings → "Send anonymous usage data". Country-only geolocation, ephemeral session IDs, no persistent identifiers. Off in one tap. Privacy Promise on encorpora.io updated to match.
Pure learning.
